summary: Iteration 7 verification of iter-6 admin connectivity layer (weekly cancel policy, cancellations registry + filters, admin request city/date filters, 4 new financial stat cards, clear-suspension endpoint/button, users cancels-<id> counters, audit-logged cancels, role isolation). The single failure is TEST-STATE POLLUTION only (seed request IDs req_1/req_d1/req_d2 pushed off the 200-row /api/business/requests window by hundreds of TEST_* requests accumulated across prior iterations) — NOT a code bug. (Carried from iter-5, still open) Send returns 200 + demo_otp even for admin/staff phones; block only happens at /verify. Minor role-leak via response-time / token waste.

issues: (Carried from iter-3/4/5) native <input type=date/time> instead of shadcn Calendar/TimePicker.

critical_code_review_comments: Weekly cancel policy: worker.py::cancel_job correctly maintains worker_profile.cancel_week=YYYY-Www + cancel_count_week atomically; increments lifetime cancel_count; applies temp suspension when >= cancel_weekly_limit; audit-logs 'driver_cancelled'. Verified via test_iteration6::TestWeeklyCancellationPolicy passing.
Cancellations registry: GET /api/admin/cancellations returns 86 rows joined with request/worker/business context, party+kind filters work, business token receives 403. Verified live.
Admin request filters city/date_from/date_to: all three testids present and functional; date filter uses ISO string >= comparison on start_date (works because the field is stored as ISO date string).

AdminDashboard: 4 new financial cards (stat-wallet-balances=23,988, stat-reserved-total=39,700, stat-driver-earnings=1,008, stat-cancellations=86/22 replacements) render live and are anchored <a> tags for navigation. GET /api/admin/stats returns all 5 new financial keys.

AdminUsers worker tab exposes cancels-<id> counter chip when cancel_count>0 (verified '18 cancels · 2 this week' on +966500000201) and clear-suspension-<id> button conditionally when suspended_until is in the future.
Backend clear_cancel_suspension endpoint: audit-logs, unsets suspended_until, resets cancel_count_week=0, sends notification. Test-callable path used by test fixture _ensure_w1_active.
Business cancel path also writes cancellations row (party='business', kind='cancellation') with reason — visible in registry (rows labelled 'شركة الإمداد السريع...' with 'إلغاء من المنشأة').
Role isolation: business token → 403 on /api/admin/cancellations (confirmed via test_cancellations_forbidden_for_business).
Weekly-limit setting bounds: PATCH /api/admin/settings accepts cancel_weekly_limit=3, rejects 99 with 400 (test passes).
State-pollution risk: /api/business/requests has no pagination and no cleanup for TEST_* rows; over 200 test-created requests now hide the seed IDs. Recommend TTL/cleanup task or explicit pagination.

rca of the issue: test_isnad_backend.py::test_list_requests_has_delivery_seeded fails because GET /api/business/requests returns exactly 200 rows (no pagination) and 200+ TEST_* requests from iters 3-7 now sit ahead of req_1/req_d1/req_d2. Reproduction: `curl .../api/business/requests` while authenticated as +966500000101 → len=200, seed IDs absent. Mitigation options: (1) add ?limit/?offset pagination and update the test to page through, (2) add a scheduled cleanup for TEST_* requests older than 1 day, (3) sort by created_at ascending so seed rows come first.
